title: Pyne Pod Fresh Mint Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pyne Pod NicSalts Fresh Mint 10ml E-Liquid provides a highly straightforward and deeply refreshing botanical vape. This blend captures the pure, natural essence of fresh Mint leaves, offering a crisp inhale that immediately cools the mouth. Bypassing heavy confectionery sweetness, it delivers a clear, natural-tasting finish that works perfectly as an palate cleanser or a reliable all-day option for those who prefer unadulterated cooling flavours. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Pyne Pod Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Pyne Pod Nic Salts collection translates the intense, highly popular flavours of their renowned prefilled pods into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the crisp purity of Fresh Mint, vapers can explore other irresistible blends such as the sweet nostalgia of Blue Razz GB, the rich berry notes of Strawberry Cherry, or the tropical warmth of Mango Passion Fruit.
